approach: When the two speeds each last for equal time, the average speed is the arithmetic mean, found from total distance over total time.

steps.text: Let each half of the total time be t, so the total time is 2t.
Find the distance covered in each half from distance = speed multiplied by time.
Average speed is total distance over total time.

common_mistakes.text: Using the harmonic mean 2v₁v₂/(v₁+v₂), which applies only when the two parts are equal in distance, not equal in time.
